title: clematis alpina var. iliensis
intro: Clematis alpina var. iliensis, commonly known as the 'Iliamna Clematis' or 'Alpine Clematis', is a flowering plant species belonging to the Clematis genus. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate stress, improve sleep, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Clematis alpina var. iliensis include sedation, analgesia, and anti-anxiety effects, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety disorders and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which have been shown to possess medicinal properties.
